description: Three-node ring positive signed-loop benchmark with a separate upper-band branch ambiguity zone.
expected_behavior: Nonzero signed loop law on trusted center loops; top-band continuation ambiguity excluded as R4.
notes: Response uses excess circulation (raw minus branch baseline) to separate path-induced pumping from static chirality bias.
Pairs excluded from the signed-loop fit are marked by explicit R4/R3/R2 exclusion reasons.
